verdict.rationale: PostHog's experiments docs say you define variants, pick the metrics you care about, and PostHog randomizes users, tracks exposures, and runs the statistics (Bayesian or frequentist). That covers A/B tests with goal metrics and statistical analysis. Supporting surfaces include an Experiments tool category (40 MCP tools) and Experiment status shown in PostHog Desktop. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how significance and results are reported (e.g. credible/confidence intervals, win probability, results view), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that the experiment statistics work as claimed.
